summary: Lenovo Legion 7i Gen 9 System State Baseline
intent: Mitigate thermal throttling and maintain optimal performance
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to excessive GPU temperatures during intense gaming sessions
suggested_solution: Fan Settings: 40-50% during light usage, 60-70% during intense gaming
Thermal Paste Application: High-quality thermal paste (e.g., Arctic Silver 5)
Cooling Solution: Liquid cooling solution or upgraded air cooling system
